question: What is the minimal causal response rank per task, and the minimal temporal/is-was union rank, that preserves the licensed rank46 OOD program?

prior_art.causal_top2: Own-task top-two modes strongly beat cross-task modes but recover only .7922 temporal and .7607 is/was behavior; their rank-at-most-four union recovers .7924/.7812 and misses the .80 program bar.
prior_art.anti_tuning: Testing only the next rank after observing the top-two miss would be adaptive threshold chasing, so the full finite ladder is frozen before execution.

selection: Within each family choose the smallest declared rank whose temporal and is/was behavior projections are each at least .80, worst target residual is at most .15, control margin RMS at most .10, median full-vocabulary KL at most .02, and control flips are zero. Ties are impossible because rank is the primary key.

predictions.pred_a_authority_disjointness_finiteness: The causal-factorial/rank46 authorities reproduce, fit and evaluation IDs are disjoint, source tripwires pass, all values are finite, and exactly 42 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_nested_coordinate_capture_is_mono: Mean coordinate projection is nondecreasing to tolerance .01 with rank for both tasks in both own and union ladders.
predictions.pred_c_an_own_task_rank_at_most_four_is_: The own-task ladder selects a jointly sufficient rank no greater than four.
predictions.pred_d_a_union_task_rank_at_most_three_i: The union ladder selects a task rank no greater than three (installed union rank at most six).
predictions.pred_e_selected_compression_is_selective: At least one selected arm uses installed rank below eight at every site and passes all target/control gates.

decision: A-E passing licenses a lower-rank task-conditioned response executor. Otherwise report the complete minimal ranks and retain the full rank-eight pooled interface wherever the frozen .80 gate is not met; no follow-up rank tuning is allowed.
